`final class ShaderPassContext`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.shader.pipeline` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ShaderPassContext.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/shader/pipeline/ShaderPassContext.java)

What a shader pass needs to know about the area it runs on, the part of it rendered and the framebuffer that holds it.

## Description

[`ShaderPipeline`](/reference/shaders/shaderpipeline/) builds it and passes it to [`IShaderPass.bind`](/reference/shaders/ishaderpass/#IShaderPass-method-bind).
The area is in the coordinates you draw in; the region is the part of the expanded area that is visible on screen, which is what the framebuffer holds.

## Learn more

- [Shaders](/use/learn/going-further/shaders/)

### Position and size

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `double` | [getX](#ShaderPassContext-method-getX)() | Returns the left of the area, before the expansion. |

### Queries

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `float` | [getTexelWidth](#ShaderPassContext-method-getTexelWidth)() | Returns the width of one texel of the framebuffer, on 1: use it to step by one pixel in a pass. |

| `double` | [getRegionWidth](#ShaderPassContext-method-getRegionWidth)() | Returns the width of the rendered region. |
| `double` | [getRegionHeight](#ShaderPassContext-method-getRegionHeight)() | Returns the height of the rendered region. |
| `int` | [getTextureWidth](#ShaderPassContext-method-getTextureWidth)() | Returns the width of the rendered region, in screen pixels. |
| `int` | [getTextureHeight](#ShaderPassContext-method-getTextureHeight)() | Returns the height of the rendered region, in screen pixels. |
| `int` | [getFrameBufferWidth](#ShaderPassContext-method-getFrameBufferWidth)() | Returns the width of the framebuffer, at least the texture width. |
| `int` | [getFrameBufferHeight](#ShaderPassContext-method-getFrameBufferHeight)() | Returns the height of the framebuffer, at least the texture height. |

### of

`ShaderPassContext of(double x, double y, double width, double height, double expansion, double margin, PixelGrid grid)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>
